name: Loom
pitch_then: Build a tool for sharing and collaborating on videos and presentations online; later a screen-recording messenger.
became: Pivoted to async video messaging; Atlassian bought it for about $975M in 2023.

name: Socialcam
pitch_then: Mobile app for capturing, editing and sharing short videos with friends, built by the team behind a live-video site.
became: Autodesk bought it for about $60M in 2012, eighteen months after launch.

name: Remix
pitch_then: Online tool that lets city planners design and test public transit routes using map data.
became: Via bought it for about $100M in cash and stock in 2021.

name: Paperspace
pitch_then: Cloud-hosted virtual computers you can use from any device, aimed at designers and developers.
became: Moved into GPU cloud for AI; DigitalOcean bought it for $111M in 2023.

name: Product Hunt
pitch_then: A simple daily list where people share and vote on new tech products.
became: AngelList bought it for about $20M in 2016.

name: Chariot
pitch_then: Crowdsourced commuter shuttle vans running routes that riders vote on in San Francisco.
became: Ford bought it for a reported $65M in 2016; shut down in 2019.

name: Flutter
pitch_then: Webcam-based hand gesture recognition to control music and video players on a computer.
became: Google reportedly paid about $40M in 2013 and folded the team in.

name: HackPad
pitch_then: Real-time collaborative text documents for teams, built as a web editor.
became: Dropbox acquired the team in 2014 and folded it into Paper.

name: Tilt
pitch_then: Mobile app for friends to pool money for group purchases and gifts.
became: Airbnb acquired it in 2017 and shut the app in 2017.

name: Pixate
pitch_then: Design tool for building interactive mobile app prototypes with animations.
became: Google acquired the team in 2015 and shut the product.

name: Screenhero
pitch_then: Screen sharing with remote control and voice for pair programmers.
became: Slack acquired the team in 2015 and shut the product.

name: Kimono Labs
pitch_then: Point-and-click tool that turns any website into an API.
became: Palantir acquired the team in 2016; Kimono shut down.

name: Smyte
pitch_then: Software to detect and block spam, fraud and abuse on online platforms.
became: Twitter acquired it in 2018 to fight abuse.

name: Escher Reality
pitch_then: Backend software for shared, persistent augmented reality experiences across phones.
became: Niantic acquired it in 2018 for Pokemon Go AR.

name: Meetingbird
pitch_then: Calendar and scheduling tool that finds meeting times and tracks people you meet.
became: Dropbox acquired the team in 2018; the app shut down.

name: Framed Data
pitch_then: Machine learning platform that predicts customer churn from app data.
became: Square acquired the team in 2016.

name: Raven Tech
pitch_then: Voice assistant platform and smart speaker for Chinese users.
became: Apple reportedly acquired it in 2017.

name: Vidpresso
pitch_then: Tools for turning social media posts and comments into live TV graphics.
became: Facebook acquired the team in 2018.

name: Breaker
pitch_then: Social podcast app for discovering and sharing shows.
became: Twitter acquired it in 2021 and shut it down.

name: Slapdash
pitch_then: Launcher that searches across all of a team's work apps at once.
became: Notion acquired it in 2021 and shut it.

name: OneGraph
pitch_then: Single GraphQL API to connect to many third-party services.
became: Netlify acquired it in 2021.

name: Humanloop
pitch_then: Platform for building and evaluating applications on large language models.
became: Its team joined Anthropic in 2025.

name: Fig
pitch_then: Autocomplete and shortcuts for the command line terminal.
became: AWS acquired it in 2023; the product was sunset in 2024.

name: Paribus
pitch_then: Service that watches your online purchases and claims refunds when prices drop.
became: Capital One acquired it in 2016 and shut the service.

name: Standard Treasury
pitch_then: Developer API platform to help banks offer modern software access to accounts.
became: Silicon Valley Bank acquired it in 2015.

name: Wit.ai
pitch_then: Speech and natural language API that lets developers add voice commands to apps.
became: Facebook acquired it in 2015.

name: BufferBox
pitch_then: Locker network in Canada for picking up online orders.
became: Google acquired it in 2012 and shut it in 2013.

name: SourceDNA
pitch_then: Tool that scans mobile apps for shady code and malware.
became: Lookout acquired it in 2016.
